cause: Background invalidates view generation. Idle busy=false/scanning=false/uri-empty setters can all bail out; active previously performed no state update, so the enabled Scan retained its retired render ticket.
changes: Track actual background passage in the existing AppState listener and increment viewEpoch on return to active, even when all visible idle state values were equal. No global revalidation of an old ticket.

Refresh restore, original outbox/journal projection, session reconciliation, proposal and exact original-request review effects on the foreground epoch. Their old async closures remain fenced and cleaned up.

Gate all active operation entry callbacks by their render-owned account/generation and actual active AppState before taking a fresh begin() lease. Late old buttons cannot start Pair, disconnect, review decision, status/retry/ack or relay retry in the new foreground.
Gate explicit cancel/close by the same render ownership. Cancel advances the visible epoch even when its notice and other state values repeat, so it cannot leave Scan stale.
Scanner result handling remains render-owned and only fills the URI. No automatic Pair, approval, signature, replacement transaction or submission.

Temporary biometric inactivity does not trigger the foreground epoch and does not invalidate an active-operation generation. Existing active-only completion checks and 120-second active-operation TTL are unchanged.

tests.method: Extract actual component hooks, AppState listener, Scan/result handlers and action declarations, using a minimal hook scheduler that bails out on equal state and compares the actual effect dependency arrays. Real WalletConnectViewOperations and WalletOperationLifecycle are imported; protocol collaborators are isolated fixtures. No shared SDK source is imported or executed.
